description_en: Invokes the ListCustomRoutingEndpointTrafficPolicies operation to query the list of endpoint traffic policies for a custom routing type listener
description_zh: 调用ListCustomRoutingEndpointTrafficPolicies接口查询终端节点流量通行目标列表（自定义路由类型监听）
name: ListCustomRoutingEndpointTrafficPolicies

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance. Set the value to ap-southeast-1
parameters.help_zh: 全球加速实例所在的地域ID，仅取值cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The page number of the list. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for a paged query. Maximum value: 50. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的条目数。最大值：50。默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance for which you want to query traffic policies
parameters.help_zh: 待查询流量通行目标列表的全球加速实例ID
parameters.name: accelerator_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the listener for which you want to query traffic policies
parameters.help_zh: 待查询流量通行目标列表的监听ID
parameters.name: listener_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the endpoint group for which you want to query traffic policies
parameters.help_zh: 待查询流量通行目标列表的终端节点组ID
parameters.name: endpoint_group_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the endpoint for which you want to query traffic policies
parameters.help_zh: 待查询流量通行目标列表的终端节点ID
parameters.name: endpoint_id

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the traffic policy destination
parameters.name: address

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the list

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page in a paging query
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时每页的条目数

AcceleratorId.description_en: The instance ID of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance to which the endpoint belongs
AcceleratorId.description_zh: 终端节点所属全球加速实例ID

Address.description_en: The IP address of the traffic policy destination

EndpointGroupId.description_en: The ID of the endpoint group to which the endpoint belongs
EndpointGroupId.description_zh: 终端节点所属终端节点组ID

EndpointId.description_en: The ID of the endpoint to which the traffic policy belongs
EndpointId.description_zh: 流量通行目标所属终端节点ID

ListenerId.description_en: The ID of the custom routing type listener to which the endpoint belongs
ListenerId.description_zh: 终端节点所属自定义路由类型监听ID

PortRanges.description_en: The port range of the traffic policy destination
PortRanges.description_zh: 流量通行目标端口范围

items.description_en: The port range of the traffic policy destination
items.description_zh: 流量通行目标端口范围

FromPort.description_en: The start port of the traffic policy destination for processing requests
FromPort.description_zh: 流量通行目标处理请求的起始端口

ToPort.description_en: The end port of the traffic policy destination for processing requests
ToPort.description_zh: 流量通行目标处理请求的结束端口

ServiceId.description_en:
The ID of the service to which the managed instance belongs.
This parameter is valid only when ServiceManaged is set to True
ServiceId.description_zh:
托管实例所属的服务方ID。
仅在ServiceManaged参数为True时有效

ServiceManaged.description_en:
Indicates whether the instance is managed. Valid values:
true: The instance is managed.
false: The instance is not managed
ServiceManaged.description_zh:
是否为托管实例。取值：
true：是托管实例。
false：不是托管实例

ServiceManagedInfos.description_en:
The list of action policies that the user can perform on the managed instance.

This parameter is valid only when ServiceManaged is set to True.
When the instance is in the managed state, user operations on the instance are restricted, and certain operations are prohibited
ServiceManagedInfos.description_zh:
用户在此托管实例下可执行的动作策略列表。

仅在ServiceManaged参数为True时有效。
当实例处于托管状态时，用户对实例的操作会受到限制，某些操作行为会被禁止

items.description_en: The list of action policies that the user can perform on the managed instance
items.description_zh: 用户在此托管实例下可执行的动作策略列表

Action.description_en:
The name of the managed policy action. Valid values:
Create: Create an instance.
Update: Update the current instance.
Delete: Delete the current instance.
Associate: Reference or be referenced by the current instance.
UserUnmanaged: Unmanage the instance.
CreateChild: Create a child resource under the current instance
Action.description_zh:
托管策略动作名称，取值：
Create：创建实例。
Update：更新当前实例。
Delete：删除当前实例。
Associate：引用/被引用当前实例。
UserUnmanaged：用户解托管实例。
CreateChild：在当前实例下创建子资源

ChildType.description_en:
The type of the child resource. Valid values:

Listener: listener resource.

IpSet: acceleration region resource.

EndpointGroup: endpoint group resource.

ForwardingRule: forwarding rule resource.

Endpoint: endpoint resource.

EndpointGroupDestination: protocol mapping resource of the endpoint group under the custom routing listener.

EndpointPolicy: traffic policy resource of the endpoint under the custom routing listener.

This parameter is valid only when Action is set to CreateChild
ChildType.description_zh:
子资源类型，取值：

Listener：监听资源。

IpSet：加速地域资源。

EndpointGroup：终端节点组资源。

ForwardingRule：转发策略资源。

Endpoint：终端节点资源。

EndpointGroupDestination：自定义路由监听下的终端节点组协议映射资源。

EndpointPolicy：自定义路由监听下的终端节点通行策略资源。

仅在Action参数为CreateChild时有效

IsManaged.description_en:
Indicates whether the managed policy action is managed. Valid values:

true: The managed policy action is managed. The user cannot perform the action specified by Action on the managed instance.

false: The managed policy action is not managed. The user can perform the action specified by Action on the managed instance
IsManaged.description_zh:
托管策略动作是否被托管，取值：

true：托管策略动作被托管，用户无权在托管实例下执行Action指定的操作。

false：托管策略动作未被托管，用户可在托管实例下执行Action指定的操作

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
